Name: Handsome Mr. Qi
Author: MomiChan
Description:
After going through so much effort to finally meet this Mr. Qi character who kept sending you mail, I was expecting to be greeted by someone fantastic looking. Instead, I found myself face to face with a dopey looking man. I decided to make him far more handsome, and to share it with you guys!

To install this, put the appropriate xml files into the Character/Portrait files on your computer, It should look something like:

C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Characters (This is where you put the sprite file)

C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Portraits (this is where you'll put the portrait file)

Downloads.Description: Copy these to Stardew Valley\Content\Portraits and Stardew Valley\Content\Characters

Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it's not a SMAPI mod (see https://smapi.io/xnb for info).
